description: Revoke a grant on a Google Doc. Pass `email` for a person or a group. A grant with no email — a domain-wide grant, or anyone-with-link — has no email to pass, so address it by `permissionId` from list_permissions (run that first; it also tells you the role you are about to remove). Refuses to touch the owner. `expectRole` is REQUIRED — run list_permissions first and echo the role back; a permission change is recorded nowhere and cannot be restored from version history, so this is the only thing standing between a misaimed call and a silent, unrecoverable revocation. Note a doc created under a Workspace domain may carry a domain grant nobody explicitly added.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

email.description: person or group to revoke; omit when using permissionId

expectRole.description: REQUIRED — the grant's current role as list_permissions reported it (reader/commenter/writer). Verified first: if it changed since you looked, nothing is removed. Revoking leaves no record anywhere, so this makes you look before you cut.

expectTitle.description: the doc’s title; verified before revoking so a wrong id is refused

permissionId.description: id from list_permissions — the only way to revoke a domain or anyone-with-link grant

name: unshare_doc
title: Remove someone’s access
